_howToEdit: All website text lives in this file. Change the words between the quotes, save, and refresh the page. Wrap a word in *asterisks* inside a heading to make it orange and italic. Keep the commas and quotes exactly as they are. Dates are written YYYY-MM-DD.

contact.whatsappGreeting: Hi Hunger Warriors! I'd like to know more about your Sunday drives.
contact.heading: Say *hello*
contact.intro: Have a question, an idea for a partnership, or know a community that needs us? Write to us. A Warrior will get back to you, usually within a day.

hero.headline: No one should go to sleep *hungry.*
hero.intro: Every Sunday, our volunteers cook, pack and hand out food to people in need across Kolkata. When disaster strikes, we take relief wherever it's needed most.
hero.imageAlt: The Hunger Warriors team in matching teal shirts, gathered together after a drive

about.heading: Ordinary people. *Extraordinary Sundays.*
story: Hunger Warriors began in 2019 with a handful of friends in Kolkata who couldn't look away from the hunger on their own streets. One Sunday they cooked a meal and handed it out. The next Sunday, they did it again.
Today we're a family of more than 150 volunteers of every age and background. We still turn up every Sunday, rain or shine, and when floods or cyclones hit Bengal we load up and go.
about.mission: To fight hunger in Kolkata and across West Bengal by getting nutritious food and essentials to people who need them, reliably, with dignity, every single week.
about.vision: A Bengal where no child, elder or family goes to sleep hungry, and where feeding a neighbour is everyone's responsibility.
about.imageAlt: Smiling Hunger Warriors volunteers with water and supplies during a relief drive

items.label: Every Sunday
items.title: Sunday food drives
items.text: Every week without fail, we serve hot meals, fruit and snacks to people living on the streets, outside hospitals and in the city's poorest neighbourhoods.
items.imageAlt: Volunteers serving hot food on Kyd Street

items.label: When disaster strikes
items.title: Relief drives
items.text: After cyclones and floods we take ration kits, drinking water and supplies to the worst-hit villages, even when that means going by boat.
items.imageAlt: Volunteers handing out ration kits and water after a cyclone

upcoming.heading: Where we're *headed next*
upcoming.intro: Sundays are a promise we keep every week. Relief drives come together at short notice, whenever a community needs us most. Pick a date and walk with us.

involved.heading: Become a *Hunger Warrior*
involved.intro: No experience needed, just a few hours on a Sunday and a heart that shows up. Fill this in and WhatsApp will open with your details ready to send.

ways.title: Volunteer
ways.text: Cook, pack, drive or serve on a Sunday. Bring friends or your college group.

ways.title: Donate supplies
ways.text: Rice, dal, oil, packaged food, blankets and clothes. We can arrange a pickup.

ways.title: Partner with us
ways.text: Restaurants, businesses and housing societies can sponsor a drive.

donate.heading: Turn kindness into *a full plate.*
donate.intro: We're run entirely by volunteers, so every rupee you give becomes food, ration kits and relief. See exactly what your gift can do.
